changes.item: G3: sdsj at 360 x 640 (card covered the case floor)
changes.change: Phone card (below 480 px) is shorter: the reserved 'Installation in progress' line moves out of the flow, beside 'Read the story' (absolute, still reserved, no shift), plus tighter padding and row spacing. On phones the wing head is now in the HUD row: 'Return to the aisle' takes the year chip's place (EXPERIENCE 9.2), the wing chip sits under it (portrait) or beside it (landscape). The measured wing-head bottom at 360 x 640 drops from about 140 px to about 82 px, so the F-039 framing lifts the case.
changes.evidence: mobile.spec '360 x 640: every stop' projects the glass case through the live camera and asserts no card/case intersection at all 13 stops: pass (before: sdsj card top 327 vs case bottom 354, mun 348 vs 349). review/runs/2026-10-24-wp27/before-sdsj-360x640.png vs after-sdsj-360x640.png, before/after-mun-360x640.png, before/after-sdsj-pixel7.png.

changes.item: F-046 (P3): year ticks drawn through stop dots on the desktop rail
changes.change: Each tick carries its distance to the nearest dot (--gap, a fraction of the line) and is nudged in CSS by max(0px, 8px - gap * 60vh) away from the dot, so the nudge adapts to the 60vh line height. Ticks farther than 8 px are untouched.
changes.evidence: mobile.spec 'desktop rail: F-046' asserts every tick center is at least 6 px from every dot center: pass (2025 was 5.4 px from volunteer-door at 900 px tall).

changes.change: The exit control's parentElement is still the wing head that CameraRig measures; the head still unmounts at the door on the wing track (shared helper wingHeadShown in model.ts, used by the rail and the HUD).
changes.evidence: rail-input.spec (g) passes on desktop, pixel7 and 360 x 640, inside the 94-test regression run below.

changes.change: 'Begin the walk' is a CSS ticket: admit part, dashed perforation with half notches, fixed-width 112 px stub. The stamp (day, short month, year in the visitor's locale, ticket.ts) is empty in the prerender and filled right after hydration via useSyncExternalStore. Under ?test=1 it is the frozen TEST_STAMP '15 OCT 2026' (en-CA), so baselines are stable and no visual mask is needed. Click tears the stub (400 ms, transform and opacity) while the walk starts; none under reduced motion; the stub returns when the visitor comes back to the lobby. Accessible name stays 'Begin the walk' (stub aria-hidden).
changes.evidence: mobile.spec 'onboarding' tests (stamp text, empty prerendered stamp, accessible name, tear attribute, no animation under reduced motion) and CLS with the stamp: pass; ticket.test.ts unit tests; review/runs/2026-10-24-wp27/after-lobby-pixel7.png.

changes.change: MotionChip.tsx: under prefers-reduced-motion, in museum mode at the lobby, a fixed chip 'Prefer a quick read? Open the classic view.' (link to /resume/) with a 'Close' button. Never in the prerender, so no shift. Close or following the link stores the dismissal in localStorage inside try/catch.
changes.evidence: mobile.spec 'reduced motion' (visible, clear of the HUD, dismissed stays dismissed after reload) and 'no chip without reduced motion': pass.

changes.change: The artwork title link gets 10 px padding with a matching negative margin (box at least 44 px, line height unchanged); door links are 44 px inline-flex rows.
changes.evidence: mobile.spec checks every visible button and link in the card and the HUD at all 13 stops on pixel7, pixel7-landscape and 360 x 640: pass (before: every title link 29 to 31 px tall).
